mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (indicating monetary tightening) compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates applied to future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is above 3.0%, SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (indicating stronger manufacturing activity) signals robust economic growth, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO level fails to predict positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above 1050.0 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1050.0.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate combined with a rising federal funds rate signals a tight labor market prompting monetary tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightening with monetary policy response
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 105.0), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to weak corporate earnings growth, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 105.0, SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of cases.
